summary: Fix OWASP dependency check CI failure on fork PRs without NVD_API_KEY
description:
The ` --nvdApiKey ${{ secrets.NVD_API_KEY }}` argument causes the OWASP dependency check to crash on fork PRs because forks cannot access the `NVD_API_KEY` secret, leaving it empty and triggering a CLI argument error.
This makes `--nvdApiKey` conditional on the secret being present, so the scan falls back to rate-limited NVD access when the key is unavailable instead of failing entirely.
